summary: Frontend testing of background music toggle in Header. All core functional requirements PASS: button rendered between LanguageSwitcher (lang-toggle) and theme-toggle, size 32x32 rounded-full, correct default paused state (VolumeX, color rgb(245,240,232), border rgba(255,255,255,0.15), aria-pressed=false, no boxShadow), no autoplay (0 audio elements in DOM initially, allPaused=true), toggle click flips to playing state (Volume2 icon, color rgb(231,76,26), borderColor rgb(231,76,26), boxShadow 'rgba(231,76,26,0.5) 0px 0px 8px 0px', aria-pressed=true), second click restores paused state. Audio asset GET /audio/epic_battle.mp3 returned 200, content-type audio/mpeg, content-length 8035387 (~8MB). No console errors on load. Login form selectors changed so post-login dropdown-export regression was not verified via automation, but Header code path for dropdown-export is unchanged from iter 18 (which passed).

ui_bugs.issue: Button title attribute shows raw i18n key 'music_play' / 'music_stop' instead of Turkish fallback 'Müzik Çal' / 'Müziği Durdur'. Cause: react-i18next t() returns the key string when translation is missing, so `t('music_play') || 'Müzik Çal'` short-circuits with the truthy key. Fix: either add music_play/music_stop/music_blocked translations to i18n resources, or use `t('music_play', 'Müzik Çal')` (i18next default value form) or explicit fallback check.

action_items: Add i18n keys music_play='Müzik Çal', music_stop='Müziği Durdur', music_blocked='Ses çalınamıyor' to all locale files (or use t('key', 'defaultValue') signature) so button title/tooltip renders in the user's language instead of the raw key.
critical_code_review_comments: Audio element created via `new Audio()` in useEffect is fine but consider guarding against React StrictMode double-invocation in dev (cleanup handles it here — ok).
`t('music_play') || 'Müzik Çal'` fallback pattern is broken because i18next returns the key on miss; prefer t('music_play', { defaultValue: 'Müzik Çal' }).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Music toggle verified end-to-end at https://oyun-loncasi.preview.emergentagent.com. Login form fields use different selectors (not name=username/type=text) — for future auth tests, inspect the DOM first. All feature acceptance criteria for music toggle in iteration 19 review request are met.
